articles.title: Ted Lasso returns at an important time for Apple TV
articles.description: 2026 is shaping up to be an excellent year for Apple TV. Apple's streaming service has built out an impressive slate that spans returning favorites like Silo and Sugar to all-new hits including OnlyFans-inspired dramedies, terrifying comedies, and paranoid tech thrillers. articles.title: SpaceX is coming for T-Mobile, AT&T and Verizon
articles.description: SpaceX is preparing to build a terrestrial mobile network to "acquire quite a few" of the customers now subscribed to T-Mobile, AT&T, and Verizon.
